blocks.text: These are two Names that have repeatedly come together in many aayaat of the Noble Qur'aan. Allaah said,
No vision can grasp Him, but His Grasp is over all vision. He is the Most Subtle and Courteous, Well-Acquainted with all things.
He said in mentioning the advice that Luqmaan the wise gave to his son,

"O my son! If it be (anything) equal to the weight of a grain of mustard seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Verily, Allah is Subtle (in bringing out that grain), Well-Aware (of its place).

Al-Khabeer The Fully-Aware means the One through His knowledge knows the hidden matters, sees what is hidden in the innermost conscience and the most insignificant of matters. He knows the hidden seeds and the minute atoms.

Al-Khabeer is a Name that refers back to His knowledge of hidden matters which consist of the utmost minute, tiny, concealed matters. In addition to this even more so His knowledge encompasses that of the apparent and open matters.
The Name Al-Lateef The Subtle and Kind has two meanings:
1. It has the same meaning of Al-Khabeer The Fully-Aware - that He knows the minute and insignificant details such as the secrets, inner conscience and the hidden matters.
2. Allaah facilitates what is in the interests of His servants and allies with kindness and perfection through ways they do not perceive.

keyPoints: Al-Lateef and Al-Khabeer have repeatedly come together in many aayaat of the Qur'aan.
Al-Khabeer means the One who through His knowledge knows the hidden matters, what is hidden in the innermost conscience, the hidden seeds and the minute atoms.
Al-Khabeer refers back to His knowledge of the most minute, concealed matters, and His knowledge encompasses the apparent matters even more so.
Al-Lateef's first meaning is the same as Al-Khabeer: He knows the minute details such as secrets, inner conscience and hidden matters.
Al-Lateef's second meaning: Allaah facilitates what is in the interests of His servants and allies with kindness and perfection through ways they do not perceive.
